label: D1 after a reward when the agent is about to choose a2, first ~50 trials of the episode
explanation: Reset gate 9 fires only at D1 (100% of mass), only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded), and almost only when the upcoming choice is a2 (the policy logit sits in a moderate a2-preferring band, -4.4..-1.5, and the value in a narrow 7.5-7.7 band). It is also restricted to early/mid episode: it fires at trials ~3-49 and essentially never after trial 50, so it carries a slow time-in-episode signal too. Recorded predicate uses action at D1, which is the agent own upcoming choice (marked FUTURE but computed by the agent). Closest observed-only version, (phase == D1) & (in_rew == 1) & (prev_action != 1) & (ep_trial < 50) (rewarded after an a2 choice), scores dev F1 0.71 vs 0.80 for the upcoming-choice version. Never fires at GO or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before an a1 choice. Dev precision 0.67, recall 0.99, mass recall 0.998; false positives are mostly rewarded-a2 D1 steps where it sits just below threshold. Magnitude not separately characterized.
